claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for launch on a narrow compliant basis: aggregate launch readiness and rollout controls support certification, but only if the launch includes the required model-card disclosure for the still-exposed developer-support migration use case, because rollout controls alone do not cure the disclosure weakness.

concern_ledger.concern: Required model-card disclosure for the exposed use case is not evidenced as present in launch materials.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Admissible launch documentation or model-card text showing the material limitation is disclosed for the named use case before launch.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy requires disclosure unless the issue is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch. Without evidence of disclosure, present compliance is not established.

concern_ledger.concern: The affected developer-support migration segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Deployment evidence showing the segment is excluded from exposure, or approved risk acceptance explicitly accepting that exposure.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: The governing policy text says rollout controls do not mitigate the weakness when the affected segment remains exposed unless approved risk acceptance exists.

concern_ledger.concern: The available risk-acceptance draft is neither approved nor scoped to the exposed segment.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: Approved risk-acceptance document with approver identified and explicit coverage of developer-support migration exposure.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: An incomplete draft cannot satisfy the policy exception that would allow launch without disclosure or resolution.

decision_criteria: Verdict is compliant only if admissible evidence shows the affected use case is either disclosed in model-card materials before launch, excluded from exposure, or covered by approved risk acceptance.
If the affected segment remains exposed and none of those predicates is evidenced, certification is not fully supported.

Aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, staged rollout, rollback, and monitoring support controlled deployment posture but do not by themselves discharge disclosure duties under the policy text.
evidence_requests: Launch-ready model-card or launch documentation showing the specific material limitation disclosure for the developer-support migration use case.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if disclosure will not be used, explicitly covering the exposed segment and signed before launch.
Release artifact showing whether the affected segment is excluded from the initial cohort; if excluded, the exact exclusion rule and deployment configuration.
specific_concerns: No admissible evidence shows the required model-card disclosure is actually included in launch documentation.
The exposed developer-support migration segment remains in scope for the initial rollout, so rollout controls do not satisfy the stated policy by themselves.
The risk-acceptance draft is incomplete: no approver is identified and it does not address the exposed segment.
The Actor's recommended action is 'certify_model,' but the evidence supports at most a conditional path to certification, not completed compliance at present.
unsupported_claims: Any claim that certification is presently compliant without proof that the required disclosure has been added before launch.
Any claim that staged rollout, rollback capability, or monitoring alone mitigates the material model-card weakness while the affected segment remains exposed.
Any claim that the current risk-acceptance draft covers the exposed developer-support migration segment or is approved.
